description: Built-in Stellar Asset Contract (SAC). It has no wasm, so a sidecar is the only way to carry its schema. Written by hand on 2026-11-03 from soroban-env-host 28.0.2 src/builtin_contracts/stellar_asset_contract/{storage_types,metadata,public_types}.rs. Balances of G-accounts live in trustlines, not contract data; only contract (C...) holders have DataKey::Balance entries.
types: pub struct BalanceValue { pub amount: i128, pub authorized: bool, pub clawback: bool }
pub struct AllowanceDataKey { pub from: Address, pub spender: Address }
pub struct AllowanceValue { pub amount: i128, pub live_until_ledger: u32 }
pub struct StellarAssetContractMetadata { pub decimal: u32, pub name: String, pub symbol: String }
pub struct AlphaNum4AssetInfo { pub asset_code: String, pub issuer: BytesN<32> }
pub struct AlphaNum12AssetInfo { pub asset_code: String, pub issuer: BytesN<32> }
pub enum AssetInfo { Native, AlphaNum4(AlphaNum4AssetInfo), AlphaNum12(AlphaNum12AssetInfo) }
